When somebody says, "I am God, so I can kill," take it as a sign they could really hurt someone. To lead them back to not hurting anyone, start from what they believe, like the lines below do by saying God is in everyone. Arguing ("No you're not," "That's delusional") can make them dig in to prove they're God. And if you nod along as if hurting someone could be spiritually fine, they might hear it as permission.

It might look passive, but this is how you become unhookable. When you meet a demon with love, the demon has nothing to hook into, since its hooks only catch on hatred and fear.

If someone's too overwhelmed to send love, because they're sick or too scared to think straight, help them get steady first, with the lights turned down and a doctor if they need one. Leave the demon talk until they can think straight again.
